jobs.command:

from pathlib import Path
import re,os,datetime
q=Path('/opt/homebrew/Cellar/python@3.14/3.14.7/Frameworks/Python.framework/Versions/3.14/lib/python3.14/subprocess.py');s=q.read_text().splitlines()
print('PID',os.getpid(),'UTC',datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat())
names={'poll','wait','_internal_poll','_wait','_try_wait','send_signal','terminate','kill','_handle_exitstatus'}
for start,line in enumerate(s):
 m=re.match(r'(\s+)def (\w+)\(',line)
 if not m or m.group(2) not in names:continue
 indent=len(m.group(1));end=start+1
 while end<len(s):
  l=s[end]
  if l.strip() and len(l)-len(l.lstrip())<=indent and not l.lstrip().startswith('#'):break
  end+=1
 print('INSTALLED_METHOD',m.group(2),start+1,end)
 for i in range(start,end):print(f'{i+1}: {s[i]}')
PY
